title: Shadow Traffic: Feature Flag + Staged Rollout Plan (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
body:
Owner: Talia Benson (EPM)
Last updated: 2026-02-21
Reviewers: Sean Gallagher (SRE), Allison Grant (Observability), Ethan Park (Control plane), Mina Haddad (Routing), Logan Wright (Telemetry), Dylan Brooks (Console), Jonas Weber (Evals), Marcus Lin (Security)

Purpose
This doc defines the feature flags and staged rollout plan for Shadow Traffic quality metrics (mirroring sampled production requests to shadow variants and scoring asynchronously). It is written for release engineering + oncall readiness: what we enable when, for whom, and how to shut it off safely.

Principles / release guarantees
- Fail-open: shadow path failure must never affect user response.
- Overhead budgets: shadow mirroring must remain within agreed CPU/latency overhead, and scoring must be backpressured without impacting routing.
- Safety by default: conservative sampling defaults; redaction/retention enforced; audit logs for experiment actions.
- Progressive delivery: internal dogfood -> internal opt-in tenants -> Dedicated beta allowlist -> GA gating.

Definitions
- Control path: the request used to generate the user-visible response.
- Shadow target(s): one or more candidate variants receiving mirrored traffic (new model version, quant profile, routing policy).
- Shadow artifacts: redacted prompt/context, control+shadow outputs, scoring outputs, aggregates.

Flag framework assumptions
- All flags below are supported at three levels (most restrictive wins):
  1) Global environment flag (prod/stage)
  2) Tenant allowlist (org_id / tenant_id)
  3) Route/rollout object configuration guard (shadow_policy attached to route/rollout)
- Kill switches must be reachable by oncall (SRE) without code deploy.
- “Enabled” means code paths are active; user must still configure a shadow policy to generate traffic.

Flag inventory (by component)

A) Control plane: policy schema + validation
- Flag: shadow_policy_api_enabled
  - Scope: control plane API + storage
  - Default: OFF in prod
  - When ON: allow create/update of shadow_policy objects via Console API; validation enforced.
  - Notes: creation without data plane enabled is allowed for dry-run UX.

- Flag: shadow_policy_validation_strict
  - Scope: validation rules (cardinality-safe constraints, streaming rules)
  - Default: ON in stage, OFF in prod initially
  - When ON: reject configs that exceed safety bounds (see “Guardrails”)

B) Routing/data plane: request mirroring
- Flag: shadow_mirror_enabled
  - Scope: router / smart routing dataplane
  - Default: OFF in prod
  - When ON: router may mirror requests if route has shadow_policy and bucketing chooses “shadow”.

- Flag: shadow_mirror_streaming_enabled
  - Scope: streaming request handling semantics
  - Default: OFF initially
  - When ON: streaming requests mirrored per documented capture rules (partial capture, timeout).

- Flag: shadow_mirror_timeout_enforced
  - Scope: strict timeouts + circuit breaker integration
  - Default: ON whenever shadow_mirror_enabled is ON

C) Telemetry: event emission + ingestion
- Flag: shadow_telemetry_emit_enabled
  - Scope: router emits shadow_pair events (control/shadow linkage + minimal dims)
  - Default: OFF

- Flag: shadow_telemetry_ingest_enabled
  - Scope: ingestion pipeline accepts shadow events, writes to storage tables
  - Default: OFF

- Flag: shadow_telemetry_dims_strict
  - Scope: drops/normalizes unsafe dimensions; caps label lengths
  - Default: ON when ingest is ON

D) Redaction + retention
- Flag: shadow_artifact_redaction_enabled
  - Default: ON when any artifact storage is ON
  - Behavior: enforce allowlist fields, prompt truncation, hashing, PII regex passes

- Flag: shadow_artifact_storage_enabled
  - Default: OFF
  - Behavior: stores redacted artifacts; enables example drilldowns.

- Flag: shadow_artifact_retention_override_enabled
  - Default: OFF
  - Behavior: allows per-tenant retention changes (Dedicated/Private only) behind approvals.

E) Scoring pipeline
- Flag: shadow_scoring_queue_enabled
  - Default: OFF
  - Behavior: enqueues scoring jobs for shadow pairs.

- Flag: shadow_scoring_workers_enabled
  - Default: OFF
  - Behavior: workers pull from queue and compute metrics (eval-harness templates + heuristics).

- Flag: shadow_scoring_modelgraded_enabled
  - Default: OFF initially
  - Behavior: enables model-graded rubrics; use conservative concurrency and spend caps.

- Flag: shadow_scoring_backpressure_enabled
  - Default: ON when queue/workers ON
  - Behavior: circuit breaks job creation when lag exceeds thresholds.

F) Console + APIs
- Flag: console_shadow_experiments_ui_enabled
  - Default: OFF
  - Behavior: Console shows “Shadow Experiments” navigation, create flow, and results pages.

- Flag: console_shadow_experiments_api_enabled
  - Default: OFF
  - Behavior: CRUD + query endpoints in Console backend.

- Flag: console_shadow_examples_enabled
  - Default: OFF
  - Behavior: enables example sampling/drilldown (requires artifact storage).

G) Alerts + automation
- Flag: shadow_quality_alerts_enabled
  - Default: OFF
  - Behavior: alert rules for quality regression and scoring lag activated.

- Flag: shadow_quality_rollout_gates_enabled
  - Default: OFF (advisory-only for beta)
  - Behavior: attaches quality deltas to rollout timelines; does not auto-rollback unless explicitly enabled in later phase.

H) SDKs
- No runtime flags; SDK methods gated by API availability.
- SDK rollout is version-based; see “GA criteria”.

Guardrails (config-time + runtime)
- Sampling rate caps by environment:
  - Stage: up to 25% allowed (for testing)
  - Prod internal tenants: max 5% default; allow up to 10% with SRE approval
  - Beta Dedicated tenants: max 3% default; allow up to 5% with explicit customer + SRE approval
- Shadow targets per policy: max 2 targets in beta (to limit cost + cardinality)
- Shadow mirror timeouts: hard timeout <= 250ms connect + <= 1s end-to-end for mirroring attempt (shadow path only); no retries inline
- Circuit breaker triggers:
  - Shadow target error rate > 10% over 5m OR p99 shadow attempt time > 1s -> disable shadow mirroring for that route for 10m (cooldown)
  - Scoring queue lag > 30m -> stop enqueuing (store minimal metadata only)
- Telemetry dimensions:
  - No raw prompt_id, user_id, customer_id as metric labels
  - Hash route_id into low-cardinality buckets for default dashboards; full fidelity only in logs/table queries with access controls

Staged rollout plan

Phase 0: Stage environment validation (pre-prod)
Goal: verify flags work, event schemas stable, and all kill switches are effective.
- Enable in stage only:
  - shadow_policy_api_enabled
  - shadow_mirror_enabled
  - shadow_telemetry_emit_enabled + shadow_telemetry_ingest_enabled
  - shadow_artifact_redaction_enabled + shadow_artifact_storage_enabled
  - shadow_scoring_queue_enabled + shadow_scoring_workers_enabled (heuristics only)
  - console_shadow_experiments_api_enabled + console_shadow_experiments_ui_enabled
- Success gates:
  - No increase in stage router p99 beyond +2% when sampling <= 10%
  - No metrics/ingestion cardinality alerts triggered by default dims
  - Scoring backlog stable (<10m typical)

Phase 1: Internal dogfood (prod, internal tenants only)
Goal: exercise real prod traffic at low sampling and validate oncall runbooks.
- Prereq:
  - INT-912 approved (internal tenant enablement + audit note)
  - Dashboards live (quality deltas + scoring lag)
  - Oncall runbook reviewed (Confluence: shadow-traffic-rollout-and-rollback-runbook)
- Enable (prod):
  - shadow_policy_api_enabled: ON (tenant allowlist only)
  - shadow_mirror_enabled: ON (tenant allowlist only)
  - shadow_telemetry_emit_enabled: ON (tenant allowlist only)
  - shadow_telemetry_ingest_enabled: ON (global ON, but write-path filtered by allowlist)
  - shadow_artifact_redaction_enabled: ON
  - shadow_artifact_storage_enabled: ON (allowlist only)
  - shadow_scoring_queue_enabled + shadow_scoring_workers_enabled: ON (allowlist only)
  - console_shadow_experiments_api_enabled + console_shadow_experiments_ui_enabled: ON (allowlist only)
  - shadow_quality_alerts_enabled: ON (route to tickets only during first week)
- Defaults:
  - sampling: 1%
  - 1 shadow target max
  - disable model-graded scoring (heuristics only) unless Jonas/Karthik approve rubric run
- Success gates (7-day window):
  - No S1/S2 incidents attributable to shadow traffic
  - Shadow mirroring overhead within budget (router p99 +0.5% at 1% sampling)
  - Scoring lag p95 < 20m

Phase 2: Limited Dedicated beta (customer allowlist)
Goal: validate Dedicated isolation, retention knobs, and customer UX.
- Enable (prod):
  - Expand tenant allowlist to 2–4 Dedicated customers selected by PM (Marissa/Paula)
  - Keep Hosted disabled for external customers in beta
  - shadow_artifact_retention_override_enabled: ON (Dedicated allowlist only; requires security signoff)
  - shadow_scoring_modelgraded_enabled: ON for select tenants only (explicit spend caps)
  - shadow_quality_alerts_enabled: ON (page on scoring lag only if it blocks beta dashboards; quality regression alerts are advisory)
- Customer communications:
  - Customer must acknowledge: data retention defaults + redaction limitations + sampling/cost impact
- Success gates (2–3 weeks):
  - At least 1 successful canary decision informed by quality delta dashboard
  - No sustained ingestion lag > 60m
  - No unresolved cardinality alerts triggered by beta tenants

Phase 3: GA readiness (Hosted + Dedicated; Private handled separately)
Goal: broaden availability and harden controls.
- Enable (prod):
  - console_shadow_experiments_* flags ON by default (still requires policy config)
  - shadow_policy_api_enabled ON broadly (all tenants), but policy creation respects plan/entitlements
  - shadow_mirror_enabled ON globally, but mirroring only occurs when:
    1) tenant entitled, 2) route has policy, 3) sampling > 0, 4) circuit breaker healthy
  - shadow_quality_alerts_enabled ON (paging policy finalized)
- GA gates:
  - SLOs for shadow path documented + alerting tuned
  - Pricing/packaging toggles integrated (entitlements)
  - SDKs released (Python/TS/Go) with docs quickstart

Private deployments plan (separate track)
- Default stance: ship code paths behind flags, OFF by default.
- Private enablement requires:
  - Customer-specific retention/storage backend decision
  - Option to export to SIEM or local store
  - Optional air-gapped scoring mode or “no model-graded scoring” configuration

Entitlements + gating
- Beta: Dedicated only; allowlist via tenant_id
- GA: package-gated (Hosted tiers TBD by PM-1845), Dedicated included by contract addendum if needed
- Private: contract + deployment-specific configuration

Rollback / disable instructions (component-by-component)
Note: rollbacks must be flag-based first. Code rollbacks only if flags fail to stop the problematic behavior.

1) If user-facing latency increases (router p99/p99.9 regression)
- Immediate action:
  - Disable shadow mirroring first: shadow_mirror_enabled OFF (global) OR remove tenant allowlist
  - Keep policy API + Console UI on (optional) for debugging, but no mirroring should occur.
- Confirm:
  - Router metrics return to baseline; shadow attempt counters drop to zero.

2) If shadow targets are failing and causing noisy telemetry (but user path fine)
- Action:
  - shadow_mirror_enabled OFF for affected tenant(s) (prefer tenant-level)
  - If tenant-level control not available in dataplane, set sampling=0 at route policy as an immediate workaround.

3) If telemetry ingestion is lagging or cardinality alerts fire
- Action sequence:
  - Turn off emit: shadow_telemetry_emit_enabled OFF (stops new events at source)
  - If needed, turn off ingest: shadow_telemetry_ingest_enabled OFF (global) and page Observability owner
  - Ensure shadow_telemetry_dims_strict is ON when re-enabling
- Follow-up:
  - Reduce allowed dims; enforce route bucketing; validate “prompt_id” not present as label anywhere

4) If scoring backlog grows (queue lag) or workers destabilize
- Action:
  - Disable workers: shadow_scoring_workers_enabled OFF
  - If lag continues or enqueue is too high: shadow_scoring_queue_enabled OFF
  - Keep artifact storage ON if needed for later replay, but note cost
- Confirm:
  - Queue depth stabilizes / stops growing; enqueued job count drops

5) If artifact storage is causing cost spikes or compliance concerns
- Action:
  - shadow_artifact_storage_enabled OFF (tenant-level preferred)
  - Keep shadow_artifact_redaction_enabled ON (do not disable)
  - If necessary for incident response: set retention to minimum allowed; coordinate with Security (Marcus/Kevin)

6) If Console UI/API causes load or user confusion
- Action:
  - Disable UI: console_shadow_experiments_ui_enabled OFF
  - Disable API: console_shadow_experiments_api_enabled OFF
  - Leave backend ingestion/mirroring flags as-is if customer already running and we only need to hide UI

7) If alerts are too noisy
- Action:
  - shadow_quality_alerts_enabled OFF
  - Keep dashboards active; refine thresholds before re-enabling paging

Oncall “big red button” recommendation
- Create a single composite kill switch in flag service:
  - shadow_traffic_global_kill_switch
  - When ON: forces shadow_mirror_enabled=OFF, shadow_telemetry_emit_enabled=OFF, shadow_scoring_queue_enabled=OFF, shadow_scoring_workers_enabled=OFF (Console UI can remain ON)
- Owners: SRE (Sean) + Release Eng (Talia)
- Target: before Dedicated beta starts

Checklist before enabling for a new tenant (beta)
- [ ] Tenant entitlement recorded (package/beta allowlist)
- [ ] Sampling <= 3% and targets <= 2
- [ ] Redaction enabled and retention set per policy
- [ ] Dashboards verified for tenant (quality deltas, scoring lag)
- [ ] Alerts set to ticket-only for first 72h unless otherwise agreed
- [ ] Customer success + support briefed (support macro + escalation path)

Appendix: Quick reference table
Component | Primary flag(s) | Safe rollback
- Policy API | shadow_policy_api_enabled | OFF (prevents new config)
- Mirroring | shadow_mirror_enabled | OFF (stops shadowing immediately)
- Streaming | shadow_mirror_streaming_enabled | OFF
- Emit | shadow_telemetry_emit_enabled | OFF
- Ingest | shadow_telemetry_ingest_enabled | OFF (use only if necessary)
- Storage | shadow_artifact_storage_enabled | OFF
- Scoring | shadow_scoring_workers_enabled / shadow_scoring_queue_enabled | OFF workers first, then queue
- Console | console_shadow_experiments_ui_enabled / api_enabled | OFF
- Alerts | shadow_quality_alerts_enabled | OFF

Open questions / TODOs
- Finalize paging policy (what pages vs tickets) for scoring lag and quality regression (owner: Sean/Allison; due before Phase 2)
- Confirm exact sampling caps by tier (owner: Marissa/Paula)
- Confirm model-graded scoring spend caps + rate limits (owner: Jonas/Karthik)
- Document Private deployment storage/export options and default OFF stance (owner: Ethan/Marcus)
